LESSON: LANGUAGE GROUPS IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: General
Strand: PEOPLE, POPULATION AND SOCIAL ORGANISATIONS Strand Sub strand Specific Learning 
Topic 2.1: Language groups in Eastern Africa
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language groups in Eastern Africa, part of PEOPLE, POPULATION AND SOCIAL ORGANISATIONS Strand Sub strand Specific Learning  in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six General.

Key inquiry question: Why do people migrate?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language groups in Eastern Africa together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: Learners brainstorm in groups the classification of communities in Eastern Africa according to language

groups.

● Self-efficacy: Learners draw the movement routes followed by the selected language groups on a map of Eastern Africa.

Values:

● Unity: Learners appreciate themselves as they discuss in groups the effects of movement and settlement of selected

language groups in Eastern Africa and do presentations in class.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PICs):

● Self-awareness: Learners are able to understand themselves as they do a library research and write down the communities
